A Sikhay and Valiger Collaboration

Math you can feel
not just see

RADIAN is an ESP32-powered classroom device that teaches trigonometry, vectors, matrices, and polygon angles through physical rotation — with real-time feedback on a companion app.

Try the DemoView on GitHub

4

Teaching modes

20Hz

BLE update rate

0.1°

Encoder accuracy

Four Modes, One Dial

What RADIAN teaches

1

Degree / Radian

Unit circle, arc length, sin / cos — read live off the dial.

2

Vector Addition

Two arms combine into a resultant with live magnitude and angle.

3

Rotation Matrix

A 2×2 transform applied in real time, with its geometric effect.

4

Polygon Snap

Interior, exterior, and central angles snap as sides are added.
